== June 2017 partial and source-image chronology ==
The shared [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|official PDF]], cover dated text as of June 1, 2017, prints this partial on page 10. Visible on this partial frame: title, destiny 1, Interrupt icon, A New Hope expansion icon, Lost Interrupt label, lore, full game text and E mark. The source’s blank artwork window is retained without reconstruction. Side, set name and rarity follow the source context and original printing. Full faces are first located in repository records of 8 July 2018 and 16 August 2023. First publication days are not established. Descending moves retain article and Talk history. Existing current gameplay <code>2_132</code> and Card redirect follow the latest full face, now [[Ghhhk (PC Errata 3)]]; historical publications invent no executable IDs. All existing secondary image fields, non-PC Versions entries, documented IDs and self markers remain intact. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).
